comment: Applied after interface-overlay.json, only to macOS test packages (scripts/macos_package.py), never to the development home or the Windows package. A test package shares its version with the Windows release, so it must not report to or update from the project's production services: no Sentry telemetry or failure uploads (telemetry), no statistics (statistics), no update check or self-install (mirrorchyan_rid and github; both must be absent for the client to skip updates). scripts/macos_interface.py fails the package if a removed key, or any value it had in interface.json, is still present. The window title names the commit the package was built from.
